en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus Bin Abdul Rahman, from one of his companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘There isn’t anything coming out from the Presence of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic until it is begun with Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, then with Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>, then by one after another, lest our<sup>asws</sup> later ones should be more knowledgeable than our former ones’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Yunus ibn ‘Abd al-Rahman from some of his people from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following. “

Nothing comes from Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High, except that first it begins with the Messenger of Allah then Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) then the Imams one after the other so that the last us would not be more knowledgeable than the first of us.”
